name: Ossathra, the Caldera Wyrm
place: world boss of Vharlen: the crater lake at the heart of the Caldera (zone the_caldera, levels 18-20). Arena ~50 m radius of open, walkable shore and shallow lake round her basalt island, with room for 4 basalt columns, 4 quench sluices and a magma well. Run by the realm event director (PLAN §5.2): announced 10 min ahead, free waystone travel while it runs.
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). The province WORLD BOSS. A wyrm of black scales and magma who sleeps in the crater lake. P1 'The Waking' (to 65%): a claw cone, a fire breath down a narrow cone, magma spat at random players that leaves lava pools, a wing gust down a line, and the Caldera Roar — a blast the size of the crater; hide behind a basalt column. A MAGMA WELL in the middle heals her if the tank lets her stand in it. P2 'The Lake Boils' (65% to the end of her first bar): she sinks into the boiling lake behind a ward of steam while vent wisps and salamanders come up the shore — OPEN ALL FOUR QUENCH SLUICES to flood her vents and break it — while the lake boils up in scalding pools and geysers follow everyone. P3, a new bar 'Beneath the Water': she DIVES. The lake bulges under a player (four of you hold it down), the undertow drags everyone in, lava fountains leave only four basalt islands safe, and her tail breaches in spokes; crawlers come up the shore. P4, a second new bar 'Molten Wrath': she sweeps her breath in three cones, glass falls on everyone, a ring of fire round the crater, and a last interruptible roar that brings more of the lake out. Soft enrage from 5.5 minutes, hard at 10. OWNER #51 (2026-10-15): the phase that refilled the health bar is removed; the health bar is the whole fight.
party: Built for a crowd (10-60). 5 players: the soak (need 4) and the islands are the whole fight; doable but tight. 2-3: not intended — the director should not run it below ~8 players in band. M5 scaling: health and add waves by the players enrolled (PLAN §5.2); soak need = clamp(players/5, 2, 5), stack need = clamp(players/4, 3, 8); magma spit +1 per 10 players.

pull: The crater lake boils. A head the size of a house rises out of the steam.
Ossathra opens one eye. The lake turns orange around it.
THE MOUNTAIN IS MINE. THE ISLAND IS MINE. YOU ARE FUEL.
say.death: Ossathra sinks into the crater lake with a roar that shakes the whole island. The water slowly stops boiling.
say.reset: Ossathra slides back under the boiling lake. Bubbles mark where she sleeps.

enrage.say: THE MOUNTAIN WAKES WITH ME. BURN.

soft.say: The crater gets hotter. Ossathra grows stronger.

breath.name: Magma Breath
breath.say: Ossathra rears back, throat glowing — get out of the front!

spit.name: Magma Spit
spit.say: Gobs of magma rain down — and the lava stays!

wing_gust.name: Wing Gust
wing_gust.say: Ossathra spreads her wings at {target} — get out of the line!

roar.name: Caldera Roar
roar.say: THE ROAR! Get behind a basalt column!

boil.name: The Lake Boils
boil.say: The lake boils over — scalding pools everywhere!

geysers.name: Steam Geysers
geysers.say: Geysers rise under everyone — keep moving!

vents_wake.name: Vents Wake
vents_wake.say: More things crawl out of the boiling shallows!

phases.name: The Lake Boils
phases.say: Ossathra sinks into the boiling lake! Steam pours off the water!

ward.say: Ossathra hides in a ward of steam. Smash all four quench sluices open to flood her vents! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.
ward.fade: The ward fails by itself. No opening this time.

onEnter.say: Ossathra hides in a ward of steam. Smash all four quench sluices open to flood her vents! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.

do.say: Four sluices open! Cold water floods her vents and Ossathra comes up choking out of the steam!
Every basalt column is broken. The next roar will catch everyone!
